theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (U K : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen U → IsCompact K → Convex ℝ K → K ⊆ U → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x P Q) U) → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖ ∧ |a x P Q - a y P Q| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖
